scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply chetbot-dev --env dev --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply chetbot-prod --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:dev: npm run songs:build && wrangler d1 execute chetbot-dev --env dev --remote --file seed/songs.sql
scripts.db:seed:prod: npm run songs:build && wrangler d1 execute chetbot-prod --env production --remote --file seed/songs.sql
